title: Shadow Grid
description: Access the regional substation hub to download critical power routing vulnerability logs.

hints: The code starts out with the number of letters in Eddie's middle name.
The middle of the code is the width of the fireplace measured in vertically-positioned bricks.
The code ends with the width of the fireplace measured in horizontally-positioned bricks.

config.instruction: The diagnostic tunnel is unstable. Map the grid's weak points, or clone the badge credentials and sell substation access to a buyer.
